title: Einstein Trust Layer: Prompt Defense, PII Masking & Zero Retention

steps.prompt: Why is the Einstein Trust Layer zero-retention architecture essential for enterprise healthcare and financial services Salesforce deployments?

options.label: Customer data sent to external LLMs is masked in-flight, never retained by model vendors, and not used for training
options.rationale: Customer data and PII sent to 3rd-party LLMs is masked in-flight, never retained by the LLM vendor, and never used to train foundational models.

options.label: Customer data is tokenized on-premises and decrypted exclusively within customer-hosted private VPC enclaves
options.distractorAntipattern: The Einstein Trust Layer is a Salesforce-managed cloud security architecture, not an on-premises tokenization proxy.
options.rationale: The Trust Layer operates natively within Salesforce cloud infrastructure rather than relying on customer on-premises encryption hardware or private VPC tunnels.

options.label: Prompt transcripts are stored in temporary Salesforce cache and automatically purged from CRM storage upon session end
options.distractorAntipattern: Zero retention agreements apply to external foundation model providers, while in-org audit trails are preserved for governance.
options.rationale: Zero-retention guarantees apply to external LLM vendors; within Salesforce, audit records are intentionally retained for compliance, tracing, and analytics.
